answer: A hardware-rooted identity gate requires each wallet to present a device attestation from a secure enclave at signup and at every grading call, so one physical machine maps to exactly one valid identity. A sybil farm running on a single dune of cloned servers cannot mint distinct enclave signatures without owning N real devices, and any replayed pigment of a captured attestation is rejected by the nonce-bound proof. Honest users hold one genuine yarrow of hardware per account; the attacker must buy N separate physical machines, each with its own sealed key, not script one box.
